method: Read full visible bodies of all three archived substantive pages: terms a636ebdb3ab5.txt (general, Payment, Paysafe, Independent Contractor and Platform Terms), FAQ af8de1996d1e.txt, public Contractor Agreement 9453c9a9e751.txt. facts.text: Terms Definitions: “No cryptocurrencies, indices, equities, or real financial instruments are supported” and defines assets as FX instruments. FAQ 'What instruments can I trade?' says “forex pairs, commodities, and more.” Same scope of simulated instruments; confirm exact current platform.
facts.locator: General §1 Definitions; FAQ https://lv.ls/faq/ > What instruments can I trade?

facts.text: FAQ 'What happens if I pass Level 6?' says “Once you pass level 6, you’ll start earning payouts!” whereas public Trader Contract says “starting benefit at Level 10”. Different level structures are expressly possible in FAQ; scope must be reconciled before coding this as another B4.
facts.locator: Performance Benefits; FAQ https://lv.ls/faq/ > What happens if I pass Level 6?

facts.text: FAQ says “you won't lose your payout” if pips fall after passing a payout level; contractor terms §9.2 preserve compensation for completed and accepted services subject to individual agreement.
facts.locator: What happens when I reach a level with a payout, but then lose pips?; terms Independent Contractor §9.2

facts.text: Payment §3–5 and Platform §2.5 deny entitlement from evaluation fees/metrics alone; compensation, if applicable, governed by separate written contractor agreement. Public contract provides benefit milestones. Do not equate evaluation with earned compensation.

rejected.B1: Evaluation metrics not entitlement, but public contractor agreement provides performance benefits and §9.2 preserves accepted compensation; no earned reward explicitly removable at sole discretion.
rejected.B3: Platform §1.3 generic continued-use amendments, and contractor §12 amendments require written bilateral agreement. No explicit retroactive change clause.
rejected.B7: Public contractor agreement available at /contract/; separate relationship alone not withholding.
rejected.B2: Termination of access for any reason under Platform §7.1 not expressly forfeiture of earned contractor benefits.
rejected.CONS: No numeric best-day consistency limit; level progression is pip target.
